title: Map Flow Step Inputs and Outputs
summary: Define and validate flow step mappings so generated flows are replayable and contract-safe.

modules.title: Write the Mapping Contract
modules.objective: Make all step inputs and outputs explicit before replay.

steps.instruction: Generate the component schema for each step and list available input/output fields.
steps.expected_output: Step-level schemas are available for mapping.

steps.instruction: Add or update the mapping file using typed source and target fields.
steps.expected_output: The flow mapping file includes the new step mapping.
Replay succeeds without missing field or type conversion failures.

deprecated_commands.command: rename mapping fields by string replacement
deprecated_commands.reason: String replacement can silently break typed flow contracts.
